audience: academies and course creators that sell memberships and courses in FreshLearn

useCases.title: Count and list members
useCases.text: Count the members that match a filter. Then list them, newest first, by email, text, source or creation time.

useCases.title: Find who completed a course
useCases.text: List course completions, most recent first. List the course enrollments of one member by email.

useCases.title: Review payments
useCases.text: List payments filtered by member email, status or payment platform. Open one payment by its id.

useCases.title: Review assessment results
useCases.text: List assessment attempts, newest first, with the score, pass or fail, and the result of each question.

useCases.title: Create a member and enroll them
useCases.text: Create a member with an email, full name and source. Then enroll the member in a course with a payment record. Enrolling grants course access.

useCases.title: Remove a member from a course
useCases.text: Remove a member's enrollment, which removes course access. Nothing changes if the member is not enrolled.
